filesystem: APFS, internal system Data volume; approximately 658 GiB free
cache: OS filesystem/SQLite caches warm; no cache flush; each query warmed once
layout: 1000 immediate group directories, each 999 empty files; no deep path stress
threads: single Rust query/update loop; native serial FSEvents dispatch callback
memory_metric: TASK_VM_INFO phys_footprint (current) and ledger_phys_footprint_peak (kernel lifetime peak); bytes
limitations: No private corpus, cloud placeholder, content, model, GUI, long-name pressure, or upstream comparison measurement.
Live socket timings use a Python client, not per-query CLI process startup.
Incremental measurements change one file at a time in a 999-file directory; no full-rescan concurrent query latency measurement.
